# 00000002059

**UA-09 ★** — source: 54_泛代数与范畴论.md

**English.** Conjecture: An explicit basis exists for the Zariski closure operator on systems of equations over the free group F₂: the closure of a two-variable system is generated by commutator subword conditions (the basis is a finite list); the algebraic-geometry closure of F₂ has dimension 1 (no two-dimensional closures).

**中文。** 猜想：自由群 F₂ 上的方程组的 Zariski 闭包算子的显式基:二元方程组的闭包由换位子子词条件生成(基为有限列表);F₂ 的代数几何闭包的维数为 1(无二维闭包)。
